name: airplane-t12
description: Original matrix T12. Airplane mode ON before launch, so the app never has network. The startup stats upload is enqueued and can never complete, which is the precondition for the 'wedged flusher' behaviour observed on shared-core 42637e1f: the ON_STOP flush produced no disk write at all. Re-run to see whether that still holds after the c3ba1cba stats rework.

steps.why: long enough for a startup/periodic stats upload to be enqueued and stall with no network — that stalled upload is the condition under test, not incidental
covers the ~5s background network cutoff plus at least one ~30s timed flush after backgrounding
